title: 2026 UK ETS hospital/small-emitter METS, target and cessation QA controls

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for hospital or small emitters: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK ETS: Hospital and Small Emitter status

facts.source_fact: The HSE how-to-comply guidance was updated in March 2026 for the METS system and revised cessation definition.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the current system and definition vintage.

facts.source_fact: HSE operators must monitor greenhouse-gas emissions for each scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Keep scheme-year boundaries explicit.

facts.source_fact: HSE operators must report greenhouse-gas emissions by 31 March in the following year.
facts.expected_handling: Track reporting deadline separately from target status.

facts.source_fact: HSE operators must not exceed the emissions target for the relevant scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Do not replace target compliance with raw emissions alone.

facts.source_fact: HSE permits for the 2026-to-2030 period include emissions targets for that period.
facts.expected_handling: Attach allocation-period vintage.

facts.source_fact: Where initial targets were based on estimated emissions, regulators can calculate later-year targets when necessary information becomes available.
facts.expected_handling: Treat estimated targets as revisionable.

facts.source_fact: A small-emitter HSE must notify the regulator by 31 March if reportable emissions exceed the specified annual threshold in a scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer transition without the notification/compliance record.

facts.source_fact: An HSE based on primarily providing hospital services must notify the regulator if that status condition stops being met.
facts.expected_handling: Carry eligibility basis.

facts.source_fact: Temporary monitoring-method changes require regulator notification under the applicable monitoring rules.
facts.expected_handling: Record method-change provenance.

facts.source_fact: Exceeding monitoring-tier thresholds or equipment nonconformity requiring corrective action triggers notification duties.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently keep old monitoring quality status.

facts.source_fact: Out-of-operation measurement equipment triggers a notification requirement under the monitoring rules.
facts.expected_handling: Flag data-gap provenance.

facts.source_fact: An installation ceases operation when all regulated activities have permanently ceased.
facts.expected_handling: Use the regulatory definition rather than ordinary-language closure.

facts.source_fact: The cessation date is the date regulated activities were last carried out.
facts.expected_handling: Attach last-activity evidence.

facts.source_fact: Operators notify cessation details through METS.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve system submission evidence.

facts.source_fact: The guidance defines timing rules for cessation notification based on cessation and scheme-year dates.
facts.expected_handling: Track deadline from the documented event date.

facts.source_fact: Notification is not required in the specified case where regulated activities resume before the notification date.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mark cessation permanent without checking resumption.

facts.source_fact: Following cessation, permit-surrender requirements apply through METS under the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Keep surrender status distinct from cessation event.

facts.source_fact: Restarting regulated activity after permit surrender requires a permit to be in force first.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer continuous authorisation.

facts.source_fact: After surrender of an HSE permit, the guidance states there is no provision to re-enter as an HSE during the 2026-to-2030 period.
facts.expected_handling: Apply allocation-period scope.

facts.source_fact: Qualifying HSEs do not surrender allowances to cover their emissions and are not entitled to free allocation.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply main-scheme allowance logic to HSE rows.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited source fact without broadening its scope.
Attach the applicable dataset, entity, geography or regulatory boundary before downstream use.
Attach reference period, release/update date and provisional/current/final status.
Carry source URL, publisher and calculation, reporting or quality-method provenance into derived outputs.
Do not convert aggregate, facility, industry or scheme-level evidence into parcel-level measured emissions without a separate parcel-binding gate.
